visible.title: Widgets visible
visible.hint: For every widget, unless a widget sets its own range

editor.hint: Hold Alt while dragging to flip snapping. Guides are set in the Style tab.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.hint: The frame the widgets are placed on; the export uses it too

fitHelp.contain: The whole video is shown; the rest of the canvas is black, room for widgets.
fitHelp.cover: The video fills the canvas and what passes it is cropped: the position chooses the part kept.
fitHelp.blur: The whole video is shown over a blurred copy filling the canvas, as social apps do.
fitHelp.stretch: The video fills the canvas, distorted when the shapes differ.

canvas.rotationHelp: The video is turned first and then fitted: a landscape video turned 90° fills a vertical canvas.
canvas.rotateWidgets: Turn the widgets with the video
canvas.rotateWidgetsOn: The widgets turn with it: they are placed on the canvas turned back, so a landscape template works unchanged.
canvas.rotateWidgetsOff: The widgets stay upright on the canvas.
canvas.noVideo: Without a video only the canvas size matters: the widgets are exported on a transparent background.

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Snap lines for placing widgets, saved with the template (never rendered). The frame edges always snap.

style.fontHint: CSS font list; the first installed one is used.
style.paletteHint: Widgets use these colors unless a color is explicitly set on the widget.

field.imageTooLarge: Images are embedded in the template: keep them under 5 MB

preview.decodeError: This video cannot be decoded on this machine (H.265/HEVC needs hardware support). Telemetry and sync still work.

widgets.testValuesHint: Type a value to see how the widget looks with it (not saved).
widgets.sampleDataHint: Preview widgets with a synthetic two minute session
widgets.empty: No widgets yet: add one to start the overlay.
widgets.selectHint: Select a widget in the list or on the video to edit it.
